req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-025 requires that every /tasks/* endpoint returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We test: (1) GET /tasks/ returns 200 with application/json (EP positive), (2) POST /tasks/ returns 201 with application/json (EP positive), (3) GET /tasks/{id} for existing task returns 200 with application/json (EP positive), (4) PUT /tasks/{id} returns 200 with application/json (EP positive), (5) GET /tasks/{id} for non-existent task returns 404 with application/json error body (NEG — error paths must also be JSON), (6) POST /tasks/ with invalid payload returns 422 with application/json (NEG boundary), (7) DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 with no body — Content-Type assertion is skipped but status is exact (BVA). Each test asserts the exact Content-Type header value including the charset suffix that FastAPI emits, and also asserts exact status codes to catch constant-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded task rows
actions: Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is a JSON array
trace: R-TASK-025: all /tasks endpoints returning a body must use application/json
tests.executable:
def test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type():
    from app.main import app
    from app.database import Base, engine
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers["content-type"]
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)

test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_task_title_max_length_boundary_returns_json
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database is initialised
Title of exactly 100 characters is at the max_length boundary
actions: Send POST /tasks/ with title of exactly 100 characters (boundary-valid)
expected: Response body title matches the 100-char input
trace: R-TASK-025 + BVA: boundary-valid payload at max_length=100 must still return application/json; catches off-by-one mutations on the length constant
tests.executable:
def test_post_task_title_max_length_boundary_returns_json():
    from app.main import app
    from app.database import Base, engine
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    client = TestClient(app)
    title_100 = "A" * 100
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_100, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    ct = r.headers["content-type"]
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == title_100
    assert len(body["title"]) == 100

test_post_task_title_max_length_boundary_returns_json()
